Powerful. Precise. Built to Perform.

Tackle Tough Jobs with Confidence.

The 2024 KIOTI TL750U-LQ is a next-generation compact track loader built for heavy-duty performance and lasting durability. Equipped with a 74.3 HP Perkins® turbo diesel engine and low-profile, vertical-lift geometry, this machine combines muscle with refined control. Whether you’re loading, grading, lifting, or trenching, the TL750U-LQ handles it all with superior balance, traction, and breakout force.

With a comfortable operator station and user-friendly layout, this machine is designed to keep professionals productive and comfortable all day.

Features may include:

Turbocharged Diesel Engine
Delivers 74.3 HP with a reliable 4-cylinder Perkins® engine—Tier 4 Final compliant with no DEF required.

Low-Profile Vertical Lift
LQ model offers vertical-lift design with a lower overall center of gravity for better stability and higher reach at full lift.

Pilot Hydraulic Controls
Smooth, responsive joystick controls reduce fatigue and offer precise operation in tight work zones.

Wide Rubber Track System
12.6” tracks provide excellent traction and ground pressure distribution, making it ideal for soft or uneven terrain.

Heavy-Duty Performance
Rated operating capacity of 2,690 lbs and tipping load of 5,380 lbs for maximum material handling capability.

Quick-Attach Mounting Plate
Skid-steer style coupler allows for fast attachment swaps with a wide range of compatible tools.

Easy Service Access
Tilt cab and rear swing-out door provide hassle-free access to engine, filters, and hydraulic systems.
